title: Input vertices have no gate type
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic circuits, and let $n,V$ be natural numbers with $V\le n$. The vertex $V$ lies below the size of the circuit for input length $n$ and has no gate type if and only if $V<n$.
